130. A person shall not make a statement, or disseminate
information that is false or misleading in a material particular
and which is likely to have the effect of raising, lowering,
maintaining  or  stabilizing  the  market  price  or  volume  of

securities 
traded  on  an  exchange

(b)

have  known  that  the  statement  or  information  is
false or misleading in a material particular.
